SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写批注〕
File No. B. D.
3.2 Special Branch Section
REPORT
Date July 5 19 39.

Subject Alleged Fortifications around Shanghai.

Made by. and Forwarded by. Supt. Tan Shao Liang

Despite exhaustive enquiries made among various
circles, no information is available regarding the
alleged construction of extensive fortifications in a
place 7 miles from the North Station for the purpose of
defending Japanese controlled area against the Settlement.
It is, however, correct that a Japanese firm known as
Lauro Import & Export Co. located in Room 411, fourth
floor of the Chung Nan Bank Building, 110 Hankow Road,
about two months ago, acting as agents for the Japanese
Authorities endeavoured to secure the services of over
100 trucks amongst Chinese lorry owners for the trans-
portation of materials for road construction including
bricks from wrecked houses to Kiangwan and Dazang.
As the Japanese firm had failed to put up security for
the lorries thus commissioned and there was danger of
these vehicles not being returned after being used, only
fifty trucks owned by the Chinese responded (Foreign
owned companies have not been approached). They are
paid $16 a day for the service with gasolene supplied by
Japanese. The attached is a translation of a copy of
agreement between Lauro & Co. and Chinese contracting
the supply of trucks which is self-explanatory.
In this connection it may be mentioned that in
1938 the service of 200 Chinese trucks were secured by
the Japanese to transport materials for the construction
of an aerodrome at Chenju.
Certain repairs have been made by Japanese to
the fortified pill boxes formerly built by Chinese
soldiers at Jukong Road Jetty, at Chang Hwa Pang,

E. H.
（印：SHANGHAI COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 17 JULY 1939）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写批注〕
档案编号 B. D.
3.2 特别处分科
报告
日期 1939年7月5日。

主题 关于上海周边据称存在的防御工事。

呈报人及转呈人：谭绍良警司

尽管在各阶层中进行了详尽的调查，但并未获得有关在北站七英里处的某地为保护日军控制区免受租界方面威胁而大规模修筑防御工事的任何情报。然而，确有其事的是，一家名为“Lauro进出口公司”（Lauro Import & Export Co.）的日商，位于汉口路110号中南银行大楼四楼411室，约在两个月前，作为日本当局的代理人，试图在中国卡车车主中雇佣一百多辆卡车，用于运输包括从被毁房屋中拆下的砖块在内的道路建筑材料至江湾和大场。由于该日商未能就所征用的卡车提供担保，且存在车辆使用后不予归还的风险，仅有五十辆中国籍卡车响应（未接触外籍公司所属车辆）。这些车辆的服务报酬为每天16元，汽油由日方供应。附件为Lauro公司与承包供应卡车的中方所签协议的译本，其内容不言自明。
在此需提及的是，1938年，日方曾征用200辆中国卡车，用于运输在陈菊（Chenju）修建机场的材料。
日军对以前由中国士兵在浦东鞠公路码头、张华浜、

E. H.
（印：上海总监公署 1939年7月17日）

wen Tsao Pang and Kau Jao, Pootung.
According to information, on June 22 and 23,
1939, a total of approximately 800 able-bodied Chinese
youths were pressed into service by the Japanese
Military Authorities for the construction of a number
of trenches along the foreshore of the Whangpoo River.
These trenches are of various lengths, ranging from one
mile to one and a half miles. They are separated by a
space of about 500 feet. These trenches which are
covered with turfs and trees as camouflage stretch
northward from Ying Ziang Village to Woosung. About
4 feet in depth and 5 to 6 feet in width, they are
triangular in shape, running parallel to a new military
highway at present under construction which forms a
straight line from Ying Ziang Village to Woosung.

文造浜（wen Tsao Pang）和高桥（Kau Jao），浦东。
据情报显示，1939年6月22日和23日，日本军事当局强行征召了约800名身强力壮的中国青年，沿黄浦江岸线修筑多条战壕。这些战壕长度不一，从一英里到一英里半不等。战壕之间相隔约500英尺。这些战壕覆盖着草皮和树木作为伪装，从殷行村向北延伸至吴淞。战壕深约4英尺，宽5至6英尺，呈三角形，与目前正在这条从殷行村至吴淞的直线上修建的新军用公路平行延伸。

pages.en:
TRANSLATION
（印：SECRET）

The following is an agreement concluded between
x x x (hereafter to be known as Party A) and Lauro Co. (here-
after to be known as Party B):-

1. That Party A hires out to Party B several motor trucks,
manufactured after 1937, at $...., National Currency, per
truck per day and that the charges will be settled once in
every five days.

2. That the trucks supplied by Party A must be mechanically
sound and perfect and that Party A will supply a chauffeur
(to each truck) with Settlement driving permit and also
lubricating oil and all risks insurance policies.
Party B will supply its own gasoline and necessary tools
or instruments to be used in loading and unloading cargo.

3. That, in case of a street accident and unexpected damages,
Party A will on its own initiative make claims upon the
insurance companies concerned.

4. That if the trucks of Party A are attacked and damaged by
a third party without reasonable cause, during the period
of hire, Party B will assume full responsibility and make
claims upon the insurance companies concerned.

5. That if a truck develops mechanical disorder, or if the
chauffeur is incapable of making running repairs, or if
a truck is out of service through negligence on the part
of the caretaker of Party A or through some unexpected
cause, which is beyond the control of Party B, Party A will
cause repairs to be made at once or will provide another
truck as a substitute.

6. That if the substitute truck is not supplied, the hire
charge for the period when the truck is not in use will be
deducted. Therefore Party A must see that all the trucks
are in good working condition.
pages.zh:
译文
（印：秘密）

以下为 x x x（以下简称甲方）与 Lauro 公司（以下简称乙方）达成的协议：-

1. 甲方向乙方出租数辆1937年以后制造的机动卡车，每辆卡车每日租金为法币 ____ 元，每五天结算一次费用。

2. 甲方提供的卡车必须机械性能良好且完好无损，甲方须为每辆卡车配备一名持有租界驾驶执照的司机，并提供润滑油及全险保单。乙方自行供应汽油以及装卸货物所需的必要工具或器械。

3. 若发生交通事故及意外损坏，甲方应主动向相关保险公司提出索赔。

4. 若在租赁期间，甲方的卡车无端遭受第三方攻击并受损，乙方将承担全部责任，并向相关保险公司提出索赔。

5. 若卡车出现机械故障，或司机无法进行临时抢修，或因甲方保管人员的疏忽或其他乙方无法控制的意外原因导致卡车停运，甲方应立即安排维修或提供另一辆卡车作为替代。

6. 若未提供替代卡车，则扣除卡车停用期间的租赁费用。因此，甲方必须确保所有卡车处于良好的工作状态。

pages.en:

7. That if Party B is unable to continue the hiring of
the trucks owing to social conditions, Party B may
notify Party A five days beforehand to stop the supply
of trucks or to cancel the agreement.
8. That Party A must employ a foreigner who, in the capacity
of an employee of Party B, is to control the workshop
and to see that the operation of the trucks is perfect.
9. That this agreement will be effective for one year and
might be extended for one more year if there are no special
circumstances or unexpected problems.
10. That Party B must assume full responsibility in securing
all passes to carry out transportation in Hongkew.
11. That this agreement is made out in duplicate, each party
is to keep a copy.
pages.zh:
-3-

7. 若乙方因社会局势原因无法继续租赁卡车，乙方可提前五天通知甲方停止供应卡车或取消协议。
8. 甲方必须雇佣一名外国人，以乙方雇员的身份管理车间，并确保卡车的运行完美无缺。
9. 本协议有效期为一年，若无特殊情况或意外问题，可再延长一年。
10. 乙方必须承担全部责任，确保护照/通行证齐全，以便在虹口地区进行运输。
11. 本协议一式两份，双方各执一份。
